notes: This file is the DRAFT machine-readable spec ↔ code manifest.
Every entry has `needsReview: true` until a human or agent verifies `owns`.
Overlap warnings below indicate features that claim the same source file — these need boundary resolution before they can be trusted.
See docs/harness-audit.md and docs/context-engineering.md for the design rationale.

invariants: Bank account filter parameter from URL query is consistently passed to all cashflow service handlers (expense, income) when present.
When bankAccountId is selected, both expense and income pages filter transaction queries to that account OR include USER_MANUAL source entries (null bankAccountId).
Income service getTotalIncome(), getIncomeEntries(), and getMonthlyIncomeSummaryFiltered() accept optional bankAccountId parameter and apply it to WHERE clause (OR with USER_MANUAL when active).
No page renders unfiltered totals if a bank filter is active; parity is enforced at query-binding time, not UI rendering time.
Capsule generation is mechanical; no LLM in the runtime loop.
capsule.md is a derived cache — never edit by hand; edit capsule.yml or context.md instead.
Every capsule ≤800 tokens, measured via the Claude-first tokenizer.
Re-running generate.mjs on unchanged sources produces zero diff.
Derivation is mechanical; no LLM in the runtime loop.
consumes[] is a derived cache — never edit by hand without re-deriving.
Idempotent: re-running derive.mjs on unchanged sources produces zero diff.
Eval execution is deterministic: same feature-status input produces byte-identical JSONL output.
No LLM in runtime eval loop; scoring is purely rule-based.
Reward values are normalized to [-1.0, 1.0] per eval item.
Eval results are advisory and must not auto-mutate feature status.
Existing features preserve all hand-curated fields on regeneration.
New features (no previous entry) use heuristics for owns[]; conservative defaults elsewhere.
--reset is the only path to force-bootstrap and is intentionally undocumented in pnpm scripts.
run-pre-push.mjs executes gates in strict order and fails fast on first non-zero exit.
Local pre-push enforcement never performs Tier 3 operations (no auto-push, no destructive git).
Done features must have passing verification and matching evidence when passingRequiresEvidence=true.
close.mjs never calls git commit — staging only (Hard Constraint).
Running close.mjs twice with no intervening changes is idempotent.
All verification gate results are recorded in feature-status.json evidence[].
No LLM in the runtime loop — pure Node.js child_process + string templating.
The harness must not bypass its own gates: apply-patch.mjs runs spec:check after each manifest edit and rolls back any change that introduces a finding.
Tier 3 operations (git push, prisma db push, etc.) require explicit user confirmation per AGENTS.md, even from a harness script.
Sub-agent invocations follow the ⚠️ CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS contract: read-only by default, allowed reads enumerated, JSON-only output schema declared.
Cheap-model friendliness: every irreducible LLM step fits within Haiku-class context + reasoning budget.
Session state transitions must log audit records: each import attempt, skip event, and status change is recorded immutably.
Financial integrity parity: every voided transaction in an import session must reverse corresponding expense and income ledger entries (atomically).
Access control invariant: import session details are accessible only to the user who owns the session (user-scoped authorization enforced).
Skipped transaction accounting: skipped record count must equal recordsCreated minus non-VOIDED imported transactions (reconciliation guarantee).
